Pitch: How browser play is changing access to retro games

Hi Mike,

I run POKOPIE, a browser-based retro game discovery site. I would like to pitch an original article about how modern browser technology is changing access to retro games, including the practical limits around controls, saves, mobile compatibility and preservation.

The article would be written for Respawn Magazine rather than republished from our site. I can include first-hand compatibility observations from building POKOPIE, while keeping the piece useful and non-promotional.

If this topic fits your editorial calendar, I can send a short outline and sample introduction.

Best,
Hugh
补充 1 句个人开发经历；不要附带多个链接。
Contributor query: GBA, NES and SNES play in modern browsers

Hello Retro Format editorial team,

I am a developer and the creator of POKOPIE, a browser-based retro game discovery project. I am interested in contributing an article comparing the real-world browser experience of GBA, NES and SNES titles, including input latency, controller support, save behavior and mobile limitations.

I found your contributor guidelines and wanted to ask whether this topic would be suitable for Retro Format or Eight Bit. I can prepare the article to your preferred length and style, with original screenshots and clearly documented testing.

Best regards,
Hugh
先询问适合哪个刊物；不要在首封邮件要求外链。
Writer application: practical guides and retro gaming features

Hello,

I am a developer, project manager and long-time gaming enthusiast. I would like to apply as a contributor with a focus on practical game guides, browser gaming and retro game history.

I currently operate POKOPIE, which has given me hands-on experience researching game metadata, testing browser compatibility and turning source material into clear guides. I can provide original writing samples and follow your editorial process.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best,
Hugh
准备 2 篇不依赖 POKOPIE 的写作样稿。
Volunteer writer application: browser and retro game criticism

Hello GameCritics team,

I am interested in contributing as a volunteer writer. My background is in software development and project management, and I am especially interested in browser games, retro platforms and the technical details that shape the player experience.

I would like to contribute criticism that explains not only whether a game works, but how controls, preservation, accessibility and platform constraints affect it. I can provide an original review sample that follows your published requirements.

Best regards,
Hugh
严格按照对方试稿要求；该渠道以作者身份为主。
